descriptionHtml:
Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 (83LY00MSAX) — Intel Core i7-13650HX | RTX 5060 8GB | 16GB DDR5 | 1TB SSD

Serious gaming power, built for smooth, high-refresh performance.

The Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 (83LY00MSAX) combines a 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13650HX processor with NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card, delivering reliable high-FPS gaming and everyday performance in Legion's tough, no-nonsense gaming chassis.

Key Specifications

ComponentDetails
ModelLenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 — 83LY00MSAX
ProcessorIntel Core i7-13650HX (13th Gen)
GraphicsNVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, 8GB dedicated VRAM
Memory16GB DDR5 4800MHz RAM
Storage1TB SSD
Display15.3" WUXGA (1920x1200), 165Hz refresh rate

Why You'll Love It

Strong, Dependable Performance The Intel Core i7-13650HX handles gaming, multitasking, and everyday workloads with ease, keeping things fast and responsive whether you're in a match or juggling apps.

Smooth Gaming Graphics The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 with 8GB of VRAM delivers solid frame rates and crisp visuals, with support for real-time ray tracing and AI-enhanced rendering for the latest titles.

Fast, Fluid Display A 15.3" WUXGA display with a 165Hz refresh rate keeps motion sharp and tear-free, giving you the competitive edge in fast-paced games.

Smooth Multitasking 16GB of DDR5 RAM keeps your games, background apps, and chat running smoothly side by side.

Fast Storage, Big Capacity A 1TB SSD means quick boot-ups, fast load times, and plenty of space for your game library and files.

Ideal For

  • Mid-to-high refresh rate gaming
  • Everyday multitasking and productivity
  • Gamers looking for solid 1080p-class performance at a great value
  • Students and casual creators who also game
